text:
maya - CS: Heads up — Veridian AI goes live with APAC pilot at 11:00 PT. They asked for a short-term rate limit bump + IP allowlist for two collector nodes.

zara - AM: ETA on volume? do they expect steady traffic or just a demo spike?

maya - CS: Demo spike first 48h, could turn steady after positive results. asked for +3x qps on their APAC route and EU fallback. want auto-revoke in 72h.

sam - Eng: ok. can we do policy: APAC route +3x qps, max burst 5x for 10s, fallback to eu-standard when apac saturated. Need IPs and exact CIDR.

maya - CS: IPs from them: 203.0.113.45 and 198.51.100.12. CIDR /32 ok.

liam - Infra: tagging this as low-risk but need ticket to config-sync. I'll provision allowlist and route override. planning window: start 2026-03-22T18:00Z, auto-revoke 2026-03-25T18:00Z. confirm?

maya - CS: Confirmed. Also capture renewal note — they're on month-to-month trial, close to renewal conversation. positive pilot reduces churn risk. add enablement touchpoint post-demo.

onboard-bot: created ticket CS-4127 for Veridian APAC allowlist and rate window. assignee: liam.

liam - Infra: applied allowlist to edge-apac and edge-eu routes, added policy snippet:```json
{
  "customer": "veridian-ai",
  "routes": ["apac-gen", "eu-gen"],
  "qps_multiplier": 3,
  "burst_multiplier": 5,
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.45/32", "198.51.100.12/32"],
  "start": "2026-03-22T18:00:00Z",
  "revoke": "2026-03-25T18:00:00Z"
}
```

sam - Eng: can we enable short-term telemetry tags so we can track per-token latency and error rates for their route? want to watch for timeouts.

maya - CS: yes please — ask product-telemetry to add tag veridian_apac_pilot. i'll schedule a 30m post-demo debrief with zara and the customer to capture feedback and renewal signals.

zara - AM: thanks. i'll prep pricing note for burst usage and a 30-day plan if they convert. will join debrief. :thumbsup:

liam - Infra: All done from infra side. Monitoring dashboards will appear under "per-customer -> veridian-ai" in ~10m. I set alert if error rate >1% or 95p latency >700ms.

maya - CS: perfect. leaving this thread open until revoke completes. tagging @oncall if anything spikes.

onboard-bot: allowlist applied to edge-apac (203.0.113.45) and edge-eu (198.51.100.12). policy scheduled for auto-revoke at 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z.
